text:
marisol: rolling out the schema_compat flag for structured_output today. starting with a small canary (5%) targeted at org:team-alpha. quick check: do SDKs respect the compat toggle by default? any client-side fallbacks we should prepare?

jason: flag name? and can you paste the rollout command so eng-infra can watch?

marisol: flag is `enable_struct_output_v2` — command we'll use: `rdctl feature set enable_struct_output_v2 --percent=5 --audience=org:team-alpha`

rachel: SDK update status: js + py already have a compat mode implemented. default is OFF. when flag=on server will emit structured payloads; SDKs will detect `schema_version` and if unsupported they'll fall back to the legacy text response and emit a deprecation warning.log.

rachel: code snippet in JS SDK (current):
```js
// opt-in required for structured outputs
client.config({ structuredOutput: 'opt-in' /* values: off | opt-in | strict */ });
```

marisol: perfect. so rollout plan: 5% -> wait 6 hours -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if no regressions. immediate rollback to 1% if error rate > 0.5% or parsing errors spike. sound ok?

alex: +1. add a guardrail: block the 100% step if any org has >0.2% schema-parse errors for 30m. also add a per-org kill switch.

nina: FYI: customer telemetry requires that we tag responses with `structured_output_flag=true` so we can filter. please include that in the API headers.

devops-bot: deploy job queued: feature-controller-v2 will apply `enable_struct_output_v2` to audience org:team-alpha at 1769958000. Watch the rollout dashboard: https://console/redwood/rollouts/enable_struct_output_v2

jason: pinging eng-qa to run smoke prompts against team-alpha org after 10m of canary traffic. will post results here. @devex can you update the migration note in /docs/sdk-migration with the `opt-in` snippet?

devex: on it, will draft a short note + code examples. will link to example prompts that reveal common mismatches (numbers vs strings, unexpected arrays).

rachel: one more SDK note: strict mode will reject incompatible structured payloads with 400 and an error tag `schema_mismatch`. we should avoid enabling strict in canary.

marisol: agreed — canary uses server-side structured emit but SDKs default to opt-in. strict only after 100% + 2 weeks.

jason: QA smoke test results: 200 requests, 0.5% parsing warnings, no user-facing 5xx. pushing to 25% now.

marisol: thanks. action items: (1) devex to publish migration doc (rachel + devex) (2) infra to run dashboards and alert on schema_mismatch > 0.2% (alex) (3) marisol will update rollout notes and schedule next bump in 6h. will post a final summary after 25% stage.

nina: noted — I'll add the `structured_output_flag` dimension to metrics pipeline.

alex: leaving a code-review ping for the feature-controller change: PR #4382 (feedback addressed). if green, infra will promote.

marisol: thanks all. will post status updates here. :rocket:
